headline: Brazil's Ibovespa Slips 2.7% Amid Broad Selloff in Retail and Real Estate
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa index fell 2.68%, led by sharp drops in shares of Casas Bahia, Cosan, Cyrela, and Cogna.
why: The Ibovespa is Latin America's primary equity benchmark, reflecting market sentiment on Brazilian monetary policy and economic performance.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Double-digit declines in key corporate stocks pulled down the overall equity benchmark.

why_moved: Sharp selloffs across retail, real estate, and industrial equities drove down the main Brazilian stock index.
